pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

/* A simple token. */
contract Token {
    mapping(address => uint256) public balances;
    address public owner;
    string public name = "Demo";
    bytes32 constant TAG = hex"deadbeef";

    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 amount);
    error Insufficient(uint256 available);

    constructor() {
        owner = msg.sender;
        balances[msg.sender] = 1_000 ether;
    }

    function transfer(address to, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
        if (balances[msg.sender] < amount) revert Insufficient(balances[msg.sender]);
        unchecked { balances[msg.sender] -= amount; }
        balances[to] += amount;
        emit Transfer(msg.sender, to, amount);
        require(block.timestamp > 0, unicode"ok ✓");
        return true;
    }
}
